## Disciplines Taught
- **Shotokan & Olympic Karate:** World Karate Federation (WKF) standard syllabus, Kata, Kumite, and official belt gradings.
- **Mixed Martial Arts (MMA):** International Mixed Martial Arts Federation (IMMAF) methodology, cage work, takedowns, submission defense.
- **Technical Boxing:** Stance, footwork, speed drills, heavy bag work, counter-punching.
- **Kickboxing:** Dutch kickboxing system, WAKO standards.
- **Kids Agility & Gymnastics:** Motor coordination, flexibility, and anti-bullying confidence starting at age 2.5 years.
- **Fitness & Fat Loss:** High-intensity combat conditioning circuits (no sparring required).
- **Katana & Traditional Weapons:** Japanese Kenjutsu blade handling and edged weapon defense.

## Age Divisions & Schedules
- **Advance Toddlers:** 2.5 to 4 Years (Agility & motor skill foundations)
- **Kids Division:** 4 to 12 Years (Karate, discipline & safety)
- **Youth Division:** 12 to 18 Years (Teens combat & fitness)
- **Adults & Professionals:** Evening batches
- **Women & Girls Exclusives:** Dedicated female-only batches on weekdays (1:30 PM – 2:30 PM) and alternate-day classes.
